_comment: Ground-truth contract for graphify's SCIP reader, derived from index.scip
Endpoints are SCIP DESCRIPTORS: the symbol tail after the 4 metadata
fields '<scheme> <manager> <package> <version>'. The reader's node ids are
an internal detail; tests match nodes/edges by descriptor via metadata.
Relations are graphify-native semantics ('calls'), NOT scip_* tags.
summary: User and Logger each define save(); process() calls each once. SCIP resolves every call to the correct class. A name-based resolver cannot (two save() defs, two save() call sites).

precision_invariants._why: A name-based resolver links each of the 2 call sites to BOTH save() defs => 4 edges (2 spurious). SCIP yields exactly these 2 correct edges. This count is the falsifiable precision claim.
